messages:
alex_ux: Quick check — field team asked for guidance on integrating signal-level telemetry into the Optimize advisor. Can we scope a small field experiment to validate eval-triggered alerts + per-tenant batching suggestions? Wanted to align on launch gates.

maya_pm: +1. Customer asks are: (1) automated eval alerts when quality drops on a prompt set, (2) realtime batching/caching recs based on traffic patterns, (3) safe quantization fallback guidance. They want a pilot with 3 tenants.

kevin_eng: For a lightweight pilot we should avoid heavy runtime changes. Proposal: run the advisor offline to surface recs and alerts for 48h, ship via feature flag to a read-only dashboard. If results look good, enable advisory webhook.

sam_research: Agreed. We need eval hooks to compute concordance and sudden delta on model outputs. Suggested minimal rule: if rolling concordance < 0.85 or delta > 0.12 across 1k samples => fire alert.

liz_ops: Ops constraints: keep latency impact = 0 (no inline eval), and ensure per-tenant suggestions don’t exceed privacy filters. We'll need retention policy for telemetry (30 days for pilot).

alex_ux: Rough launch gates I'd expect: 1) offline advisor runs for 48h on synthetic + one customer, 2) signal fidelity check (missing keys < 2%), 3) alert precision > 70% on sampled incidents, 4) runbook & rollback path. Thoughts?

kevin_eng: Implementation notes: advisor will compute usage histograms, p99/p50 seq lens, prefix reuse rate, KV cache hit estimator. Based on thresholds we'll emit recs like "increase batch size" or "enable prefix cache". Example rule snippet:

```
if prefix_reuse_rate > 0.25 and p95_latency < 120ms:
  recommend: "enable_prefix_cache"
  confidence: high
```

sam_research: Add eval-triggered guardrails: only recommend quantization when eval concordance on heldout > 0.9 and unit-cost reduction > 15%. Otherwise recommend simulated quantization for dev.

maya_pm: Pilot acceptance criteria (must-haves): 3 tenants onboarded, at least one real alert triggered & validated, recommendations accepted by tenants in at least 30% of cases, no P0 incidents. Nice-to-have: webhook + automatic toggles for dedicated customers.

liz_ops: On-call impact: alerts must include diagnostics and quick rollback commands. Example in alert: `model_variant: revert-to-f32` and `route_policy: fallback-region`. We can automate reroute but prefer manual for pilot.

kevin_eng: Timeline: Week 0-1: infra + offline advisor; Week 2: run offline on internal + synthetic; Week 3: invite 1-2 pilot tenants; Week 4: evaluate and decide go/no-go.

alex_ux: Risks: noisy eval signals, non-actionable recs, tenant distrust if we suggest aggressive quantization. Mitigations: conservative thresholds, explainability UI, and explicit tenant opt-in.

maya_pm: Ok sounds good. @kevin_eng can you draft a minimal data contract for signals (fields + retention + sampling rate) by EOD tomorrow? I'll draft pilot comms and runbook.

kevin_eng: Yep. I'll put a short spec into the runbook and ping infra.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create feature-flag `optimize-advisor-field-pilot` before tenant onboarding. :robot_face:

alex_ux: Thanks all — next check-in Thursday 11am. I'll share a concise scope doc after this thread. :thumbsup:
